verdict.rationale: Lago's docs confirm core usage-metering/subscription plumbing (plan assignment, yearly/monthly billing, usage-to-invoice conversion, no-code usage charge updates) and community reports confirm it replaces custom usage-billing code (lago-comm-2). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents tiered, volume, graduated, or per-unit charge model configuration, nor credits, commitments, or overage handling as no-code features. Missing for 10: explicit docs/screenshots of tiered/volume/graduated/per-unit pricing model configuration, credits and commitment mechanics, overage billing logic, and independent confirmation these work without custom code.
